subject: ct_vhm_pfloor

entries.note: 44.0 cm3; rule-based: the pelvic muscle funnel medial to the obturator internus band, between the pubic arch's apex and 0 mm above the ischial spine; pubococcygeus, puborectalis and iliococcygeus are NOT separated (no septum between them at 1 mm).
entries.procedural_badge: RULE-BASED (Q172): position rules + watershed on his own 1 mm cryosection photographs, bounded by his CT bone/organ labels; 44.0 cm3. The ischial-spine level that bounds the pelvic band is NOT found on his own bones: it is carried from the female by proportion (her builder's spine level is 1.3 mm above her femoral-head centres = 0.020 of her head-to-ischial-tuberosity height; applied to his own femoral heads (z -202.73) and tuberosity (z -270.0), his legs-CT slice 777). Front-to-back orientation corrected in Q172 (was mirrored). 0.2 cm3 in 1 piece(s) cut off from the main sheet was left unattributed. SIZE CAVEAT: both sides together are ~1.8x the published adult (female) levator range of 19.8-46.6 cm3 (no male volume norm found); the region likely includes perirectal/periprostatic fat, so treat its bulk as an overestimate.
